before.method: Observed same normalized base view after forced GC, recorded in local diagnostic tool output before correction

cause: Ground texture dispose was followed by re-upload of the same Texture UUID through WebGLShadowMap.renderObject. Renderer-shared depth material retained sampler state across world lifetimes.
correction: One shared MeshDepthMaterial owned and disposed per ChunkGenerator/world. No patch to third-party code; reject generation after disposal and make disposal idempotent.
scope: 15 actual browser world exchanges and3 base restores, accelerated fixed steps; not an indefinite no-leak guarantee or an FPS benchmark
